description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a logging system component capable of outputting log data. It includes a method for printing log information, potentially chained in a logging framework, allowing for customizable log handling.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface representing a logging node capable of outputting log messages and chaining to other nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message, with parameters for priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
